findings.text: package.json `postinstall` calls scripts/prepare-app.mjs, which only exists after wave 2 (1-backend-db). To keep `pnpm install` exiting 0 in wave 1, postinstall is a short `node -e` guard: if scripts/prepare-app.mjs is missing it prints a warning and exits 0; otherwise it runs `node scripts/prepare-app.mjs --generate --migrate --build` and propagates its exit code. Once prepare-app.mjs exists the guard is a no-op. The integration owner may replace it with the plain command after wave 2.

pnpm 11.21.0 forwards `pnpm test -- <file>` literally as `vitest run -- <file>`, and vitest ignores everything after `--`: the filter is dropped and the whole suite runs (confirmed with two scratch test files). `pnpm test <file>` (no `--`) and `pnpm exec vitest run <file>` filter correctly. The focused commands in the plan (`pnpm test -- tests/api/playRoutes.test.ts`, etc.) therefore run every test that exists; a failing sibling test can fail an unrelated unit.

The repo root already has a `.env` holding OPENROUTER_API_KEY, and the store packager's allowed extensions include `.env`. `.gitignore` did not ignore it before this unit. `.env`, `.env.*` (except `.env.example`), `*.db`, `*.db-wal`, `*.db-shm`, `*.db-journal`, `/data/`, `/dist/`, `node_modules/`, `server/generated/`, `test-results/` and `playwright-report/` are now ignored; semantics were checked with the same `ignore` package the packager uses. Values of .env were never read or printed.

pnpm itself added `minimumReleaseAgeExclude: ['@types/pdfkit@0.17.7']` to pnpm-workspace.yaml during the first install (0.17.7 was published 2026-10-22, under pnpm 11's one-day minimum release age). It is harmless, travels with the store package (yaml is shipped) and makes the version resolve on a lockfile-less install; left untouched. The entry becomes unnecessary after 2026-10-23.

Prisma 7.10.1 emits invalid SQLite (`DEFAULT {}`) for `Json @default("{}")`. The schema uses `@default(dbgenerated("'{}'"))` for diagnoses.answers and diagnoses.calculator, which `prisma migrate diff` renders as `DEFAULT '{}'`. Do not change it back to `@default("{}")`.

Dependency choices that deviate from 'latest' or go beyond the plan list: react-router is pinned to 7.18.4 (8.5.0 requires node >=22.22 but engines allow ^22.12.0); better-sqlite3 is declared directly at 12.11.1 (the range the adapter allows, ^12.6.0; 13.x is outside it); @types/node is ^22.12.0 (lowest supported runtime); typescript is ^7.0.2 and `tsc --noEmit` passes on it. shadcn support libraries were added (class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge, @radix-ui/react-slot, @radix-ui/react-alert-dialog, @radix-ui/react-label). NOT declared: lucide-react, tw-animate-css, supertest, jsdom, @testing-library/*. Execution dependencies (everything `dev`/`start`/postinstall needs, including prisma, tsx, vite, concurrently) are exact pins in `dependencies`; test/type tooling is in `devDependencies` with caret ranges.

`prisma validate` (and any Prisma CLI call) shows an update notice, which means the CLI contacted its update-check service. Only my verification commands did this; `prisma generate` and `migrate diff` ran with CHECKPOINT_DISABLE=1. prepare-app.mjs must set CHECKPOINT_DISABLE=1 for every Prisma CLI call (RULE-dm-19), as the plan already says.

messages.text: The postinstall guard in package.json (skip with a warning when scripts/prepare-app.mjs is missing) exists only because wave 1 runs before wave 2 creates that script. After wave 2 you may replace it with `node scripts/prepare-app.mjs --generate --migrate --build`. Also: focused test commands must be run as `pnpm test <file>` or `pnpm exec vitest run <file>`; with `pnpm test -- <file>` pnpm 11 passes a literal `--` and vitest runs the whole suite.

Schema facts for the init migration, prismaClient.ts, prepare-app.mjs and testDatabase.ts: (1) generator `prisma-client`, output server/generated/prisma, moduleFormat esm, importFileExtension ts, so import `PrismaClient` from server/generated/prisma/client.ts; (2) datasource has no `url` in schema.prisma, the URL comes from prisma.config.ts via resolveDatabaseUrl(); (3) server/db/databaseUrl.ts exports resolveDatabaseUrl(env = process.env), resolveAppRoot() and resolveDataDir(); default URL is `file:<abs app root>/data/fitpulse.db` with forward slashes, DATABASE_URL wins when set, and the data/ folder is created for the default; import it with an explicit `.ts` extension; (4) `prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema prisma/schema.prisma --script` works and its output uses `DEFAULT '{}'` for answers/calculator (valid SQLite); (5) `new PrismaBetterSqlite3({ url: 'file:...' })` round-trip was verified under tsx; (6) set CHECKPOINT_DISABLE=1 on every Prisma CLI call; (7) the Prisma CLI re-reads prisma.config.ts on every command, so DATABASE_URL set in the child env is honored by `migrate deploy`.

Diagnosis model: status is the Prisma enum DiagnosisStatus (draft | completed, default draft); rulesVersion is Int? (RULES_VERSION = 1); stage is Int?; answers, calculator and result are Json (answers/calculator default to {} at the database level, result is nullable); currentBlock defaults to 1; Company deletes cascade to diagnoses; index (company_id, status). Preference is { key (id), value String }.

package.json is owned by the backend lane and already declares react 19.3.1, react-dom, react-router 7.18.4 (HashRouter is exported from `react-router` in v7), tailwindcss + @tailwindcss/vite 4.3.3, vite 8.3.5, @vitejs/plugin-react 6.1.2, @fontsource/inter and /jetbrains-mono 5.3.0, @radix-ui/react-slot, -alert-dialog, -label, class-variance-authority, clsx and tailwind-merge. lucide-react and tw-animate-css are NOT declared; if a component needs them, report it to integration instead of editing package.json. tsconfig.json has `types: [node, vite/client]`, alias `@/*` -> `src/*`, allowImportingTsExtensions and verbatimModuleSyntax (use `import type` for types). vite.config.ts is yours: read PORT/BACKEND_PORT from the environment, bind 127.0.0.1 for `server` and `preview`, proxy `/api` to the backend.

.gitignore now ignores /data/, /dist/, *.db*, .env and .env.* (keeping .env.example), server/generated/, test-results/ and playwright-report/. system.json is not part of this unit and does not exist yet. package.json has no build_command-related script for the store (source-mode publish): scripts are dev, start, postinstall, build, typecheck, test, test:e2e, smoke:migrate, smoke:boot, smoke:store-package. pnpm-workspace.yaml has allowBuilds for better-sqlite3, prisma, @prisma/engines and esbuild; the full install reported no other package with a build script.
